description: This file implements a PHP driver class and related components for interfacing with PostgreSQL version 8, extending previously existing classes for earlier PostgreSQL versions within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It provides methods for retrieving metadata and last inserted IDs, and includes class definitions specific to handling PostgreSQL 8.

classes.name: ADODB_postgres8
classes.description: Driver class for PostgreSQL 8 extending the functionality of ADODB_postgres7, includes metadata retrieval and ID fetching methods.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_postgres8
classes.description: Record set class for PostgreSQL 8, extending the related PostgreSQL 7 record set class.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_assoc_postgres8
classes.description: Associative array record set class for PostgreSQL 8, extending its predecessor class.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from PostgreSQL, using different SQL queries depending on the provided table and column.
